title: Classic BBQ Burgers
description: Juicy backyard burgers with smoky barbecue flavor
ingredients: 2 lbs ground beef 80/20|1 tsp garlic powder|1 tsp onion powder|1 tsp smoked paprika|salt and pepper to taste|6 burger buns|6 slices cheddar cheese|lettuce tomato onion for serving|barbecue sauce
instructions: Mix beef with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt and pepper. Form into 6 patties. Grill over medium-high heat 4-5 minutes per side. Add cheese in last minute. Serve on buns with toppings and barbecue sauce.

title: Grilled Lemon Garlic Shrimp Skewers
description: Tender shrimp marinated in lemon and garlic then grilled to perfection
ingredients: 2 lbs large shrimp peeled and deveined|4 cloves garlic minced|3 tbsp olive oil|2 lemons juiced and zested|1 tsp red pepper flakes|2 tbsp fresh parsley chopped|salt and pepper to taste|wooden skewers soaked in water
instructions: Combine garlic, olive oil, lemon juice, zest, red pepper flakes, salt and pepper. Toss shrimp in marinade and refrigerate 30 minutes. Thread onto skewers. Grill over high heat 2-3 minutes per side until pink. Garnish with parsley.

title: BBQ Baby Back Ribs
description: Fall-off-the-bone ribs with homemade dry rub and sticky glaze
ingredients: 2 racks baby back ribs|2 tbsp brown sugar|1 tbsp smoked paprika|1 tbsp garlic powder|1 tbsp onion powder|1 tsp cayenne|salt and pepper to taste|1 cup barbecue sauce
instructions: Remove membrane from ribs. Mix dry rub ingredients and coat ribs generously. Wrap in foil and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight. Grill wrapped in foil over indirect heat 2 hours. Unwrap, brush with barbecue sauce, and grill over direct heat 10 minutes flipping once.

title: Grilled Corn with Chili Lime Butter
description: Sweet grilled corn slathered in a zesty chili lime butter
ingredients: 6 ears of corn husked|4 tbsp butter softened|1 tsp chili powder|1 lime zested and juiced|1/2 tsp garlic powder|salt to taste|fresh cilantro for garnish|cotija cheese optional
instructions: Mix butter with chili powder, lime zest, lime juice, garlic powder and salt. Grill corn over medium-high heat turning every 2-3 minutes until charred in spots about 10 minutes total. Slather with chili lime butter and garnish with cilantro and cotija if using.

title: Grilled Chicken Thighs with Chimichurri
description: Crispy-skinned chicken thighs served with vibrant herby chimichurri sauce
ingredients: 8 bone-in skin-on chicken thighs|2 tbsp olive oil|salt and pepper to taste|1 cup fresh parsley packed|1/4 cup fresh oregano|4 cloves garlic|1/4 cup red wine vinegar|1/2 cup olive oil|1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
instructions: Make chimichurri by blending parsley, oregano, garlic, vinegar, olive oil and red pepper flakes. Season with salt. Rub chicken with olive oil, salt and pepper. Grill over medium heat skin-side down 15 minutes. Flip and cook 10-15 more minutes until 165F internal. Serve with chimichurri.

title: Grilled Peach and Arugula Salad
description: Caramelized grilled peaches over peppery arugula with candied pecans
ingredients: 4 ripe peaches halved and pitted|2 tbsp olive oil|5 oz arugula|1/2 cup candied pecans|4 oz goat cheese crumbled|3 tbsp balsamic glaze|2 tbsp olive oil|salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Brush peach halves with olive oil. Grill cut-side down over medium-high heat 3-4 minutes until caramelized. Arrange arugula on plates. Top with grilled peaches, pecans and goat cheese. Drizzle with balsamic glaze and olive oil. Season with salt and pepper.

title: Smoky Grilled Portobello Burgers
description: Hearty grilled portobello mushroom burgers with all the fixings
ingredients: 4 large portobello mushroom caps|3 tbsp olive oil|2 tbsp balsamic vinegar|2 cloves garlic minced|1 tsp smoked paprika|salt and pepper to taste|4 brioche buns|4 slices provolone|roasted red peppers|baby spinach|garlic aioli
instructions: Mix olive oil, balsamic, garlic, paprika, salt and pepper. Marinate mushrooms 20 minutes. Grill over medium-high heat 4-5 minutes per side. Add cheese in last minute. Serve on buns with roasted peppers, spinach and aioli.

title: Grilled Salmon with Mango Salsa
description: Flaky grilled salmon topped with a fresh and fruity mango salsa
ingredients: 4 salmon fillets 6 oz each|2 tbsp olive oil|1 tsp cumin|1 tsp chili powder|salt and pepper|2 ripe mangos diced|1/2 red onion diced|1 jalapeño minced|1/2 cup cilantro chopped|2 limes juiced
instructions: Make salsa by combining mango, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro and lime juice. Season with salt. Rub salmon with olive oil, cumin, chili powder, salt and pepper. Grill over medium-high heat 4-5 minutes per side until flaky. Top with mango salsa.

title: Grilled Veggie Kabobs
description: Colorful mixed vegetable skewers with a herby olive oil marinade
ingredients: 2 zucchini cut into chunks|2 bell peppers cut into chunks|1 red onion cut into chunks|2 cups cherry tomatoes|2 cups mushrooms|4 tbsp olive oil|3 cloves garlic minced|1 tbsp fresh thyme|1 tbsp fresh rosemary|salt and pepper to taste|metal or soaked wooden skewers
instructions: Whisk together olive oil, garlic, thyme, rosemary, salt and pepper. Toss vegetables in marinade. Thread onto skewers alternating vegetables. Grill over medium-high heat turning every 3-4 minutes until tender and charred about 12-15 minutes total.

title: Grilled Pineapple Chicken
description: Tropical sweet and savory chicken with caramelized grilled pineapple
ingredients: 4 boneless skinless chicken breasts|1/2 cup soy sauce|1/4 cup pineapple juice|3 tbsp brown sugar|3 cloves garlic minced|1 tsp ginger grated|1 tbsp sesame oil|8 pineapple rings fresh or canned|green onions for garnish|sesame seeds for garnish
instructions: Whisk together soy sauce, pineapple juice, brown sugar, garlic, ginger and sesame oil. Marinate chicken 1-4 hours. Grill chicken over medium heat 6-7 minutes per side until 165F. Grill pineapple rings 2 minutes per side until caramelized. Serve chicken topped with pineapple and garnish.
